[NFCT.2.7] **One kind number space for slots and call arguments.**
`ds_kind_t` holds the value kinds a slot and a call argument share, at the
numbers `ds_slot_kind_t` already uses. `ds_slot_kind_t` is those plus
`DS_SLOT_FACT_REF`; `ds_arg_kind_t` is those plus `DS_ARG_ENCODED_FACT`. A
common kind has one number everywhere, so converting between the types is the
identity; a number belonging to one subtype is reserved in the other.

The value unions follow the same shape: `ds_value_t` holds the common members,
and `ds_slot_value_t` and `ds_arg_value_t` each repeat them under the same names
and offsets and add their own. All three enumerations and their member lists are
generated from `proto/fact_external.proto#Kind` ([RFCS.23.2]), never written by
hand ([STYL.5.9.7]).
